starter_files.contents:
# Clipcart-Style Multi-Vendor E-Commerce Backend

Build a production-oriented PHP backend for a multi-vendor online marketplace that demonstrates API design, database modeling, security, integration reliability, testing, and deployment.

## Setup
Install a supported PHP 8.5.x runtime. Add Composer only when required by the milestones. Copy the configuration example, supply local-only credentials via environment variables, and never commit secrets.

## Status
Starter outline only; complete the milestones and acceptance criteria before considering this project finished.

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

// Keep the public document root separate from source, secrets, and vendor files.
http_response_code(501);
echo "Project starter: implement the first milestone.";

required_features: Customer and supplier registration, secure password storage, role checks, and account/session management.
Product categories, product details, variants, inventory, validated image uploads, search, sorting, and pagination.
Cart persistence, server-side price calculation, inventory validation, order lifecycle, and transactional updates.
Payment-provider integration, server-side verification, webhook verification, idempotent payment processing, and failure recovery.
Supplier-specific product and order operations, authorization, inventory updates, and status history.
Shipment creation, address validation, shipping-status synchronization, webhook handling, and retry controls.
Prepared statements, validation, contextual escaping, CSRF protection, resource-level authorization, secure uploads, secret management, and audit logs.
Unit/integration tests, static analysis, Composer, migrations, structured logging, deployment documentation, CI/CD, and rollback planning.
Optional email notifications, background jobs, caching, analytics, refunds, returns, and dispute workflows.
stretch_features: Add an integration test for a failure case.
Document one architectural decision and its trade-off.
Check PHP/dependency compatibility and record the commands used to reproduce the build.

tests.name: Required feature checks
criteria: Each required feature is demonstrated with evidence.
Normal, invalid, and boundary cases are tested.
Errors do not falsely report successful completion.

tests.name: Security review
criteria: Input, output, access control, and file/database boundaries are reviewed.

tests.name: Reproducibility
criteria: Setup instructions work on a clean local environment.
Tests and validation commands are documented.

status_note: Project brief and starter material are provided; a human reviewer must verify implementation behavior and security before publication.
